global_conclusion: VK improves residual upper bounds and EF/PNT quality near sigma=1 but does not open Form C or dissolve FFML. Explicit formula techniques are the proved backbone (Stieltjes, truncated EF, signed residual); Weil test-function form and EF-dual kappa routes are under-used. Full review: six structural patterns (upper/lower, free/frozen, vacuous-if-RH, OR/AND, identity-rich, false friends); twelve missed angles ranked; dual Form_C/kappa and EF/VK pairing are the strongest correlations. Unconditional resolution count still zero.
